title: Call for Papers: 2026 National Policy Research Conference
excerpt: CPRI invites submissions on evidence-based governance, climate policy, and social innovation. Deadline for abstracts is August 30, 2026.
body: The Center for Policy and Research Innovations welcomes original research papers from academics, practitioners, and graduate students. Selected papers will be presented at the 2026 National Policy Research Conference and considered for publication in the CPRI Policy Review. Submission guidelines and templates are available through the Submissions portal.

title: Research Methods Training Series Opens for Registration
excerpt: A five-module training series on quantitative and qualitative research methods begins in August. Slots are limited.
body: CPRI is offering a free Research Methods Training Series covering study design, data collection, statistical analysis, and academic writing. The program is open to university faculty, researchers, and graduate students. Certificates will be awarded upon completion.

title: New Policy Brief: Digital Transformation in Local Governance
excerpt: CPRI releases a policy brief examining how digital tools improve service delivery in local government units.
body: This policy brief synthesizes findings from a multi-city study on digital governance. It provides actionable recommendations for local chief executives and planning officers seeking to modernize public service delivery.

title: Upcoming Dissertation Defenses – July 2026
excerpt: Public defenses for candidate researchers are scheduled throughout July. All are welcome to attend.
body: The following dissertation defenses are open to the public: (1) July 12 – Climate Risk Assessment; (2) July 19 – Education Equity Metrics; (3) July 26 – Health Systems Resilience. Venues and Zoom links will be posted on the Events page.
